name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.5.10
summary: Release v1.5.10: Viewport-safe modal scrolling across all console dialogs and sticky header/scrollable body for User Create/Edit modals.
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.5.10:
* **Global Modal Scroll Safeguard:** Added viewport-bounded `max-height: calc(100vh - 2rem)` and `overflow-y: auto` in `web/css/app.css` so all console popups remain scrollable and never clip action/save buttons on low-resolution or non-fullscreen browser windows.
* **User Create & Edit Modals:** Updated `#user-modal` and `#edit-user-modal` to use a fixed header and scrollable form body (`max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col`, `flex-1 overflow-y-auto custom-scroll`).
